title: Digital strategi: Öka lokal närvaro online

facts.fact: According to a WordStream statistic cited by the page, 72% of consumers who did a local search visited a store within 5 miles; the page says this figure applies to the US market.
facts.quote: The 72% figure - which I think is amazingly high - applies to the US market but it is probably fair to apply similar conclusions to Sweden

facts.fact: The page cites Consumer Barometer survey data stating that 95% of Swedish consumers use the Internet.
facts.quote: it is a market where 95% consumers use the Internet, 44% use mobile devices and 77% google to find information about local business.

facts.fact: The page cites Consumer Barometer survey data stating that 44% of Swedish consumers use mobile devices.

facts.fact: The page cites Consumer Barometer survey data stating that 77% of Swedish consumers use Google to find information about local businesses.
